text: If PaymentMethod is CHK, then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAccount is not allowed. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK and if CreditTransferTransaction/Creditor is not present, then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAccount is mandatory. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK and if CreditTransferTransaction/Creditor is present, then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAccount is optional.
reading: if PaymentMethod is CHK, no CreditTransferTransaction has a CreditorAccount; otherwise one without a Creditor has a CreditorAccount
